Default Ravengard dialogue. Depending on the path, Ravengard may urge you to save the city, and if Wyll is in party, will offer the quest to go to the Wyrmway. Wyll's endgame state is detremined here: He may become a Duke, the Blade of Avernus, or remain the Blade of Frontiers
context: The scene is a tense, armed confrontation with Cordula Eltan and a cadre of Upper City patriars and guards who accuse the player (and Wyll, if he’s present) of being tied to Baldur’s Gate’s recent horrors. Off-screen, Ravengard is dead and Florrick is either dead or still imprisoned, leaving no rival defender and hardening Eltan’s resolve. Cordula alleges that Wyll is Ravengard’s son who murdered his father to seize power, claiming Lady Mizora told her these things and calling him an agent of the Hells. The player may try to deny or counter the accusations — even insist Ravengard could still be saved — and in some branches a memory about Elturel’s fall (and Ravengard’s fate there) is available to the party.
